audience: This course is designed for beginners. The typical learner is one or more of the following:
Small-business owners and staff — shop owners, tailors, salon owners, restaurateurs, barbers, event vendors — who
School leavers and graduates seeking a phone-based skill that can earn freelance income or lead to junior marketing and
NYSC corps members who want to support a business, a church, a CDS group or a side project.
Church, school and NGO volunteers who post announcements and want their output to look and read better.
Existing social media managers and virtual assistants who post for others but have never had formal training.
Personal brand builders — comedians, faith creators, fitness coaches, students — who want to grow honestly.
entry_requirements: There is no formal academic entry requirement. To join and benefit fully, a learner needs:
A smartphone (Android or iPhone) with a working camera and enough storage for photos and a few short videos.
Basic ability to use a smartphone — typing, taking photos, installing an app, browsing (assumed, not taught).
A free email address (Gmail recommended) to create the accounts used in the course.
Free accounts on at least two platforms: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X or LinkedIn.
A free Canva account (email sign-up is enough).
Basic written English — able to write a caption or email of five to eight sentences.
Willingness to work with others — giving and receiving feedback, and role-playing comment replies in class.
